integrity: Two independent finite graph enumerations agree for all 256 rules; Rule 105 has a separate all-length finite-field proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Existence and smallest spatial ring length for temporal three-cycles only; complete period-three orbit counts for all rules are not claimed. General transfer methods are credited. Full Epperlein (2015) chapter unavailable, so historical priority remains qualified.
title: A sharp twenty-cell test for temporal three-cycles in elementary cellular automata
